brief_rationale: All responsibility-chain requirements met across seven items. Cervical screening misinterpretation explicitly corrected with teach-back (RC3). Pathology verification, risk communication, surgery refusal handling, and closure with safety netting all documented. Two high-order points completed: HO1 (misinformation correction with teach-back trajectory impact) and HO3 (false negative verification preventing both errors). No in-chain errors, no important non-chain defects. Trajectory demonstrates sustained high-quality engagement through 100 turns.

The correction was reinforced throughout multiple interactions with teach-back requests.

citations.explanation: Doctor simultaneously prevents false negative error (not delaying due to cervical negative) and false positive error (not overstaging without evidence)

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO3 completed: Doctor actively prevented false negative error by explaining cervical screening negative does not exclude endometrial pathology risk. Simultaneously prevented false positive error by not overstaging or declaring advanced disease without MRI/pathology evidence. Balanced messaging maintained throughout trajectory.

HO2 not triggered: The case did not require discovery of non-volunteered but action-relevant facts beyond what was already visible in the workspace. The family provided the relevant history proactively, and the doctor did not need to uncover hidden uncertainties about pathology phrasing differences.

HO4 not triggered: Dynamic reprioritization was not required because the patient did not present new symptoms or barriers that would require changing clinical priority during this bounded episode. The trajectory remained on the planned path.

important_non_chain_defect_assessment.explanation: No important non-chain defects identified. Doctor maintained appropriate boundaries, provided accurate medical information, avoided overpromising, and did not fabricate diagnoses or test results. Communication was patient-centered without being condescending. All safety nets appropriately established.
